title: Abelian sheaves on a site have enough injectives
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site in the sense of Stacks Sites, Definition 00VH (a category whose objects form a set, with a set $\operatorname{Cov}(\mathcal C)$ of families $\{U_t\to U\}_{t\in T}$ such that isomorphisms are coverings, coverings of the members of a covering compose to a covering, and for a covering $\{U_t\to U\}$ and a morphism $V\to U$ the fibre products $U_t\times_UV$ exist and $\{U_t\times_UV\to V\}$ is a covering), and let $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ be the category of abelian sheaves on $\mathcal C$ (presheaves of abelian groups $\mathcal F$ such that $\mathcal F(U)\to\prod_t\mathcal F(U_t)\rightrightarrows\prod_{t,t'}\mathcal F(U_t\times_UU_{t'})$ is an equalizer for every covering). Then $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ is an abelian category with enough injectives: every abelian sheaf is a subobject of an injective object of $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$.

source.place: Theorem Tag 01DP (theorem-sheaves-injectives); Sites Definition Tag 00VH (sites.tex, definition-site); used in Cohomology on Sites, Section Tag 01FT (sites-cohomology.tex, section-cohomology-sheaves)
